page_title: PAR 1-1 ATA | Parma v Atalanta 30/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+4' The expression of the referee Maurizio Mariani is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Marten de Roon (Atalanta) is shown a yellow card.
90+4' Maurizio Mariani has issued a yellow card to Gaetano Oristanio (Parma).
90+2' Substitution. Nahuel Estevez (Parma) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Adrian Bernabe Garcia walks off.

90+2' The game is interrupted. Marco Brescianini (Atalanta) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Parma are awarded a free kick.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
90' Isak Hien (Atalanta) commits a rough foul. Maurizio Mariani stops the game and makes a call. Parma are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
89' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
89' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
88' A substitution has been made. Giorgio Scalvini is replaced by Marco Brescianini (Atalanta).
88' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. Parma will take a free kick near the side line.
88' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
85' 1 - 1 Goal! Patrick Cutrone (Parma) fires the rebound inside the left post after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 1:1.

85' Enrico Del Prato (Parma) leaps high near the penalty spot and gets a header in from the resulting free kick. It's on target, but the goalkeeper dives to his right and denies the effort. It was a difficult header and it's always tough to put the ball inside the net from positions like that.
82' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Maurizio Mariani to decide. The relieved Atalanta players can finally celebrate.
81' Here is a change. Mandela Keita is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Christian Ordonez (Parma).
81' Substitution. Patrick Cutrone replaces Oliver Sorensen (Parma).
80' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Atalanta players aren’t happy.
79' 0 - 1 Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) scores! He latches on to a pass and produces a perfect strike from the edge of the box that goes inside the left post and past the goalkeeper.
77' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Maurizio Mariani ignores the protests.
75' Maurizio Mariani shows a yellow card to Isak Hien (Atalanta) for a tough tackle.
74' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, but it goes straight at Zion Suzuki.
73' The corner from Emanuele Valeri (Parma) is cleared away by the defence.
71' The linesman raises his flag. Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is adjudged offside.

71' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though the header was directed under the crossbar, Zion Suzuki didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough.
70' Wow, what an escape. Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
67' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) has a great chance on the edge of the six-yard box following a lofted pass, but his header lacks accuracy and flies just past the right post.
66' A precise cross aimed towards the penalty spot was met by Mateo Pellegrino (Parma). He outjumped the defence and produced a decent header which went a whisker wide of the right post.
65' Daniel Maldini goes off the pitch and Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) comes on.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) comes onto the pitch so that Gianluca Scamacca can be given a rest.
64' Ivan Juric decides to make a substitution. Nicola Zalewski will be replaced by Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta).

62' Isak Hien (Atalanta) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! It's a free kick to Parma, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
59' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Parma are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
59' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Gaetano Oristanio (Parma).
58' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. Parma earn a free kick.

57' Gaetano Oristanio (Parma) blows a clear opportunity to score a goal. He was one-on-one with Marco Carnesecchi inside the six-yard box and attempted to put the ball low into the middle of the target, but was denied by a great save.
56' The game has come to an end for Pontus Almqvist. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Gaetano Oristanio (Parma).
53' Maurizio Mariani has a clear sight and sees a foul from Enrico Del Prato (Parma). It's a free kick to Atalanta in a dangerous position.
52' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
52' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
51' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Parma, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
49' Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle. Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) commits a foul after dangerous play. Parma are awarded the free kick.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Maurizio Mariani has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is able to continue to play.
45' The fourth official shows 1 min. of added time.
45' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
45' Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta) was too forceful with his tackle and Maurizio Mariani interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Parma have a free kick.
44' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. A brilliant save by Marco Carnesecchi stops the ball from going inside the left post.
41' Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) touches the ball with his hand inside the box! That's a free kick to Parma.
38' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
38' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) bursts pass a defender and attempts to score from the edge of the area, but the shot goes high over the bar.
34' Raoul Bellanova (Atalanta) commits a rough challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for an infringement. Parma have been awarded a free kick.
33' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) is caught offside!
31' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Daniel Maldini (Atalanta) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
30' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
30' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
30' Nicola Zalewski (Atalanta) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
27' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. Free kick. Parma will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
21' Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.

19' Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Maurizio Mariani with no other option than to blow for a foul. Parma win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
14' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Atalanta.
12' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the right post.
12' Marten de Roon (Atalanta) makes a strong challenge and Maurizio Mariani blows for a foul. Parma will take a free kick.
8' Flag goes up against Gianluca Scamacca (Atalanta) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
8' Dangerous play by Mathias Lovik (Parma). Maurizio Mariani blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Atalanta.
3' Parma are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. Parma will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Maurizio Mariani.
